audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Gwen levels 2, 3 and first item and marked 1 and 4-5 even, contradicting whys[0] through whys[5], every one of which describes Fiora out-trading Gwen.
audit.why: Lunge plus Duelist's Dance vitals deal %-max-HP true damage that Hallowed Mist's resistances do nothing about, and Riposte punishes Gwen's only engage. Gwen does not out-grind her until Riftmaker plus a second item, which whys[6] states.
audit.corrected: Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Riposte as 'the whole lane' but never gives its cooldown, so there is no way to know how long the punished window lasts.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16, against Lunge at 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6, Bladework 11/10/9/8/7 and Grand Challenge 110/90/70. At rank 1 a baited Riposte is off for 24 seconds - nearly two Skip 'n Slash cycles - which is the actual size of the window the page tells you to look for.
audit.corrected: mid, whys[3], spikes[2].text and wants.you[2] now carry the 24s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fiora's healing is never mentioned, and the page implies Hallowed Mist's resistances help against her.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance heals her on every vital struck and Grand Challenge heals off the vitals it marks, so the extended fight Gwen is told to force is the fight she funds. Separately, her vital damage is %-max-HP TRUE damage - the mist's untargetability is what saves you, not its armour and MR, and conflating the two teaches the wrong reflex.
audit.corrected: late, whys[6] and wants.you[1] now name Grievous Wounds against Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge; mid keeps the emphasis on untargetability rather than resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal named on a matchup against one of the strongest self-healers in the lane.
audit.why: Both her passive and her ultimate carry the heal flag.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added at the Riftmaker timing.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still her window — you're a short-range melee and she out-trades you every time Riposte is up. The flip is level 6: now you can drop Hallowed Mist as she commits her Q-Q all-in so she ends up standing outside the fog and literally can't target you, while you slow with Needlework and grind her down with %-HP autos. The non-negotiable rule is Riposte — if her W is up, give nothing, because she'll parry your Skip 'n Slash or R, stun you, and free-trade. Bait it on a throwaway E first, then run your real combo into the mist.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still her window — you are a short-range melee and she out-trades you every time Riposte is up. The flip is level 6: now you can drop Hallowed Mist as she commits her Q-Q all-in so she ends up standing outside the fog and literally cannot target you, while you slow with Needlework and grind her down with %-HP autos. The non-negotiable rule is Riposte, 24s at rank 1 — if her W is up, give nothing, because she parries your Skip 'n Slash or R, stuns you, and free-trades. Bait it on a throwaway E, then run your real combo inside those 24 seconds.

edits.before: This is where you take the lane back. Once Riftmaker and your second item land, your %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus Thousand Cuts autos and ability healing out-grind her in any extended duel — a single Riposte can't undo a full fight the way it undid your early commits. Force long trades inside Hallowed Mist where she's stuck standing outside it and can't even target you; never let her get a clean Q-dash-vital reset on you. But close it out before she finishes Trinity-into-bruiser, because Fiora scales hard into a splitpush threat and the very-late solo-1v1 tightens up again.
edits.after: This is where you take the lane back. Once Riftmaker and your second item land, %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus A Thousand Cuts autos and your healing out-grind her in any extended duel — one Riposte cannot undo a full fight the way it undid your early commits. Carry Grievous Wounds: Duelist's Dance heals her on every vital and Grand Challenge heals off the ones it marks, and without anti-heal she simply refunds the grind. Force long trades inside Hallowed Mist where she is stuck outside it and cannot target you, and never give her a clean Lunge-vital reset.

notes: win[] and phases[].side gave Gwen levels 2, 3, first item and two items and called levels 1 and 4-5 even, which is close to the opposite of what this page's own whys say - whys[0] through whys[5] describe Fiora winning every stage up to two items, and the 47.51% win rate agrees. Corrected to Fiora at six stages, Gwen at two items. The full layer also called Fiora 'he' 18 times against 12 'she'; corrected. The number this page most needed and did not have: Riposte is 24 seconds at rank 1. The whole matchup instruction is 'if her W is up, give nothing', and 24s is long enough that baiting it genuinely hands you a free window - without the number the advice reads as 'never fight her'. Added Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge healing as the Grievous Wounds trigger. 'Thousand Cuts' was missing its 'A' in three places.
